CustomField.description: When true, End Chat soft-deletes the Teams chat via Graph after the transcript is saved to Swarm_Message__c. Requires Chat.ManageDeletion.All application consent on the MS_Graph app registration; without it the delete fails with 403 and is recorded on Case.Swarm_Chat_Delete_Error__c. Set to false to leave the chat in Teams (the original End Chat behaviour).
CustomField.label: Delete Teams Chat On End
